mcp.description: The write-capable Data API builder instance for data entry by graph-rag's reconciliation workers (graph-rag/src/data-entry.js). Its SQL login (gw_writer) is granted INSERT and UPDATE on the tables listed here and nothing else; DAB never deletes. Only graph-rag reaches this endpoint, after the authority rule says the person the worker acts for may commit to the class and attribute; every write is recorded as an AuditEvent in the graph.
